scope: Prepare an offline trusted read-only guest inventory for the existing OS qualification plan; no runtime integration or provisioning.
riskAnalysis: Operator utility is not deployed or integrated into authorization. It cannot qualify execution, write data, execute commands or call providers. Full source-batch release checks remain pending; current Preview stays unchanged.

threatModel.assets: Credential confidentiality and truthful isolation qualification evidence.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Kernel metadata or fixture input becomes closed observations, never authorization.
threatModel.abuseCases: Malformed or secret-bearing input could be echoed, impossible limits misclassified, or observations overstated as sandbox qualification.
threatModel.mitigations: Fixed kernel paths, bounded reads, strict parsers, closed sanitized output and permanent qualified:false/execution:false; independent review and no provisioning.

defects.rootCause: Initial parser did not reject impossible UID range or contradictory soft and hard resource limits.
defects.detectionGap: Initial fixtures covered lexical formats but not kernel numeric domain constraints.
defects.regression: Six focused tests plus independent boundary cases cover invalid UID widths, root IDs, contradictory limits, empty controllers and diagnostic secret canaries.
defects.historicalPrevention: Treat parsed metadata as observation only and validate domain constraints before reporting any property.

rollback: Revert only this unused operator utility and its fixtures if later qualification reveals a problem; no application runtime, resource or original evidence changes.
